method.contexts: Fresh browser, page, storage and caches per run; one browser at a time
method.nativeSimulation: Only Capacitor.isNativePlatform() returns true to follow packaged native boot service-worker bypass. No real Android bridge/WebView/device is present.
method.sampling: 8 seconds per lobby stage; per-stage main rAF deltas, long tasks, worker FPS/render counters before/after; exact diagnostic objects retained
limitations: Cloud CPU/software GPU only; cannot infer phone FPS, thermal behavior or actual APK install/Android WebView memory.
Main-thread requestAnimationFrame intervals do not count worker-rendered frames. Worker fps and render counters are separate.
Timing variation and first-load shader/source parsing can dominate; tiny sample cannot establish causation for phone lag.
Screenshot poses are explicitly sought to fixed entrance time after measurement; they do not establish real-time animation quality.
Fresh contexts do not reproduce an Android upgrade with retained localStorage, indexedDB or WebView caches.
No fixed random seed is used for the match; bot state, visibility and draw counts vary, so match timing is contextual.
Screenshot t2_1/t6 filenames identify seek requests after measurement, not a verified joint pose. Backward seek does not reset original-source visibility.
Worker FPS is an integer from its most recent diagnostic window, not an average FPS for the entire eight-second sample. Render-frame counter deltas span diagnostic snapshots.

browserProfiling.phoneLag: User reports the 445 MB APK looks identical and lags more; not independently measured on a phone.

summary.interpretation: Both artifacts exercise identical high/source model assets and identical completed lobby triangle/call counts. Very slow SwiftShader runs and overlapping source-ready timings do not establish an APK-specific Android performance regression. Match scene counts vary without fixed seed. No Android device measurement or completion/60-FPS claim.

browserProfiling.cleanup: Each launched browser was closed in finally; both temporary static HTTP servers closed; harness exited 0.

runtimeSourceComparison.onlyMainJsChange: Adds help modal link to rig-review.html and explicitly says the review has not replaced in-match actors.

runtimeFindings.reviewGlbsAccess: Separate rig-review.html page only; regular startup main help has a link. Browser request evidence follows.
runtimeFindings.lobbyBehavior: Both APKs load 15k rigged driver bodies then hide their skinned meshes and show the original source bodies in ordinary completed previews. H01 syncTencentPreview shows an unskinned sourceBody and mirrors staff transform; H02 syncTencentPreview similarly shows sourceBody and copies body transform while original hammer follows the driver parent. These source bodies do not get the 52-joint review skins.
runtimeFindings.matchBehavior: Existing high-detail GLBs and old procedural/IK runtime remain. world.addDetail() forces usesManualHero actors to high at line 272 and prepareBattlefield prewarms high; observed exact APK runs request H01 high body/staff and H02 high body/hammer, not mobile GLBs. H01 high body/staff are 60000/12000 triangles; H02 high body/hammer are 30000/8000 triangles. No rig-review H01/H02 asset replacement in match.
runtimeFindings.packagingVersusPerformance: Extra packaged review GLBs explain download/install growth. Packaging alone does not show these bytes are loaded by normal lobby/match or establish phone frame-time causation.

sharedSourceCacheKeyDefect.status: Static source finding, present in both exact release source trees; not a measured phone regression
sharedSourceCacheKeyDefect.insert: loadManualAsset() stores decoded template promises in loaded under raw manualHeroAssetUrls[key], e.g. /models/hunyuan-original/H01-C0-source.glb?v=...
sharedSourceCacheKeyDefect.release: releaseManualSourceAsset() converts same value via localAssetUrl() to absolute http(s) URL before loaded.get/delete
sharedSourceCacheKeyDefect.consequence: Keys differ, so intended source-template cache removal does not find the entry; template geometry/material/texture disposal inside that branch is bypassed. Existing clone disposal does not establish template texture release.
sharedSourceCacheKeyDefect.performanceAttribution: Potential memory retention across source preview hero switches; requires runtime/device memory measurements to quantify. Does not establish why current APK would uniquely lag.

runtimeFindings.packagedMobileBodiesVsObserved: 15000-triangle mobile body GLBs with 52 joints and existing six clips exist in both APKs, but are not the requested assets in this observed path because manual heroes are forced to high detail.

inventory.purpose: Read exact APKs, SHA256 every ZIP entry, parse GLB JSON and extract web roots; does not build APK.

browser.purpose: Serve extracted exact web roots and sequentially profile old/current/current/old with fresh browsers.
